steps.name: verify two donations before bad-book grant
do: assert(quest:GetStateBool('DoneIntro')); assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksInGame')==40); assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksDonated')==2); assert(quest:GetStateInt('GoodBooksDonated')==2); assert(not quest:GetStateBool('ReadingBook')); assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,0),quest:GetHero()), 'donated book still in inventory'); for _,name in ipairs({'BookDonated','BookOwned'}) do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorCount(name)==40); for i=0,39 do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt(name,i)==(i<2),name..'['..i..']') end end; assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,1),quest:GetHero()),'second donated book still in inventory'); Runner.twoDonationsLoaded=true; Runner.badIndex=quest:ReadGlobalGameData(1248); assert(Runner.badIndex>=2 and Runner.badIndex<quest:ReadGlobalGameData(1252)); assert(not quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt('BookDonated',Runner.badIndex)); Runner.badReady=true

steps.name: grant first grudging book and clear inventory UI
do: local key=quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,Runner.badIndex); assert(key~=''); if not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(key,quest:GetHero()) then quest:GiveHeroObject(key,1) end; assert(quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(key,quest:GetHero()))

steps.name: donate first grudging book
steps.until: quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt('BookDonated',Runner.badIndex) and quest:GetStateInt('BooksDonated')==3 and not quest:GetStateBool('ReadingBook') and not quest:IsInCutscene() and not quest:IsInMovieSequence()

steps.name: verify inventory flags counters and save
do: assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksDonated')==3 and quest:GetStateInt('GoodBooksDonated')==2); assert(not quest:GetStateBool('ReadingBook') and not quest:IsInCutscene() and not quest:IsInMovieSequence()); for _,name in ipairs({'BookDonated','BookOwned'}) do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorCount(name)==40); for i=0,39 do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt(name,i)==(i<2 or i==Runner.badIndex),name..'['..i..']') end end; for _,i in ipairs({0,1,Runner.badIndex}) do assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,i),quest:GetHero()),'donated inventory still present') end; quest:AutoSave(); Runner.badSaved=true
